decisions.quote:
Even though the replication data show a partial replication of the primary analysis of
interest (the main effect of Condition), the lack of a Condition x Block interaction fails
to support the main claim made in the original paper: adults learn categories quicker
if they have labels versus when they do not.
decisions.reason: Although the abstract notes that the key Condition x Block interaction failed to replicate, the authors frame the findings as a partial replication in Section (4) Evaluation—replicating the main effect of Condition and the verification-training correlation while failing to replicate the interaction and planned contrasts—and explicitly select 'mixed' as their overall verdict in Section 4.3 Brief Evaluation.
